title: Non-GPS Navigation
summary: Landing page in the ArduPilot wiki listing every supported way to navigate without GNSS: optical flow, beacons, wheel encoders, visual odometry/VIO cameras, motion capture and MAVLink external position.
key_takeaways: Single index of all ArduPilot GPS-free position sources
Each method links to its sensor-specific setup page

title: GPS / Non-GPS Transitions
summary: Explains configuring EKF3 with two source sets (e.g. GPS and external nav/optical flow) and switching between them in flight via RC switch, Lua script or MAVLink.
key_takeaways: EK3_SRCn_* defines up to three source sets
Switching can be automated with Lua for GNSS-loss handling

title: EKF Source Selection and Switching
summary: Reference for EKF3 source parameters (position, velocity, yaw per axis) and how fusion of multiple velocity sources works.
key_takeaways: Per-axis source selection for position, velocity and yaw
Basis for GNSS-denied and spoofing-resilience configs

title: Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) navigation overview
summary: Overview of ArduPilot's EKF2/EKF3 estimators: states, sensor inputs, innovation checks, lane switching across multiple IMUs and tuning guidance.
key_takeaways: Multiple EKF cores run per IMU with automatic lane switching
Innovation gates reject inconsistent sensor data

title: Intel RealSense T265 / VIO tracking camera setup
summary: Setup guide for using a visual-inertial tracking camera via a companion computer as ArduPilot's position source.
key_takeaways: Pose sent as VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE / ODOMETRY
Covers frame alignment and EKF origin setting

title: Non-GPS Position Estimation (MAVLink messages)
summary: Developer page listing the MAVLink messages ArduPilot accepts for external position/velocity estimates and their expected frames.
key_takeaways: Lists VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE, VISION_SPEED_ESTIMATE, ODOMETRY, GPS_INPUT
Starting point for writing your own nav source

title: Optical Flow Sensor setup
summary: How to install, calibrate and configure an optical flow sensor with a rangefinder as an ArduPilot velocity source.
key_takeaways: Flow plus rangefinder gives low-altitude velocity without GNSS
Calibration step aligns flow and gyro rates

title: ROS and VIO tracking camera for non-GPS navigation
summary: Developer tutorial wiring a VIO camera through ROS and MAVROS into ArduPilot for indoor flight.
key_takeaways: End-to-end ROS pipeline into EKF3
Frame transforms are the usual failure point

title: Using the ECL EKF (EKF2)
summary: PX4's main EKF2 guide: states, sensor fusion options (GNSS, flow, external vision, range, airspeed), aiding modes, innovation monitoring and tuning.
key_takeaways: Explains which aiding sources are required for position control
Shows how to read innovations in logs

title: Using Vision or Motion Capture Systems for Position Estimation
summary: How to feed external vision or mocap poses into PX4 EKF2 via MAVLink or ROS, including frame conventions and EKF2_EV_* parameters.
key_takeaways: ODOMETRY / VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE inputs
Frame handling ENU vs NED

title: Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) in PX4
summary: Guide to setting up a VIO pipeline on a companion computer and fusing it in PX4 for GPS-free flight.
key_takeaways: Companion runs VIO, PX4 fuses it
Includes check procedure before flight

title: Optical Flow (PX4)
summary: Configuring optical flow sensors and range finders for EKF2 velocity aiding in PX4.
key_takeaways: Flow needs a distance sensor for scale
Lists supported sensors and EKF2 params

title: Remote ID (Open Drone ID) in PX4
summary: PX4 documentation for connecting Remote ID modules over MAVLink or DroneCAN and related failsafe behaviour.
key_takeaways: Supports MAVLink and CAN Remote ID modules
Covers arming checks

title: Remote ID (ArduPilot)
summary: ArduPilot wiki page on Remote ID modules, including ArduRemoteID setup and compliance notes.
key_takeaways: Uses OpenDroneID MAVLink/DroneCAN messages
Lists supported transponder hardware

title: Open Drone ID (MAVLink microservice)
summary: Defines the MAVLink messages and flow for Remote ID between flight controller, GCS and transponder.
key_takeaways: Maps ASTM F3411 messages to MAVLink
Clarifies which component sends what

title: PX4 state estimation update (PX4 Developer Summit Virtual 2020)
summary: Slide deck from the EKF2 lead developer covering estimator changes, including operation without GPS and handling of non-GPS aiding sensors.
key_takeaways: Primary-source view of EKF2 design choices
Covers non-GPS aiding behaviour

title: PX4 Developer Summit 2025 recordings
summary: YouTube playlist of 2025 PX4 Developer Summit talks; the program included GNSS and navigation sessions, among them a talk on structure-aided visual localisation for PX4 indoors (SAVLoc).
key_takeaways: Recent community work on estimation and navigation
Recordings published gradually per Dronecode

title: PX4 Developer Summit 2025 Recap
summary: Dronecode recap of the 2025 summit, pointing to the schedule and recordings.
key_takeaways: Index into 2025 summit content

title: ArduPilot Developer Conference Kaga 2024 - schedule and YouTube links
summary: Schedule and day-by-day livestream recordings of the 2024 ArduPilot developer conference in Japan, including a 'High Altitude Non-GPS' session and a talk on a CINS (DCM replacement) attitude estimator.
key_takeaways: Day 2 stream contains the non-GPS talk
Shows current ArduPilot estimator work

title: Developer Unconference - Paul Riseborough (EKF)
summary: Forum post for the EKF talk at the 2017 ArduPilot developer un-conference in Canberra, given by the main author of ArduPilot's EKF.
key_takeaways: Design rationale behind ArduPilot's EKF
Older but still the clearest primer

title: GSoC 2022: Update ROS integration for Non-GPS navigation and off-board path planning
summary: Wrap-up of a GSoC project updating ArduPilot's ROS integration for lidar/SLAM-based non-GPS navigation and off-board planning.
key_takeaways: Cartographer SLAM feeding EKF3
Basis for later ardupilot_ros work

title: GPS-denied RTH for MAVLink systems using LoRa radio ranging
summary: Blog (shared on ArduPilot Discourse) on returning a plane home without GPS using range measurements from a LoRa radio to a ground beacon; discussion covers multilateration and EKF3 range fusion.
key_takeaways: Radio ranging as a cheap GNSS backup for RTH
Needs multiple beacons for a full position fix
